description: Розклад руху громадського транспорту is a dataset listed in Open data portal of Ukraine (data.gov.ua), a national open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Лука-Мелешківська сільська рада Вінницького району. Розклад руху муніципального автобуса за маршрутом №27 Лука-Мелешківська - Вінниця. Coverage: Лука-Мелешківська сільська рада Вінницького району. The publisher named on the listing is Лука-Мелешківська сільська рада Вінницького району. Its keywords include муніципальний автобус. The listing shows 4 download or service links in ODS. The listing shows 2022-02-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
